description: This file provides utilities for rasterizing PDF documents into PNG images using the PyMuPDF (fitz) library. It defines data structures and functions to convert each page of a PDF into a PNG image at a specified DPI, and records page sizes for further processing.

classes.name: RasterPageInfo
classes.description: Data class representing information about a rasterized PDF page, including index, image path, pixel dimensions, and DPI.

methods.name: Tuple[List[RasterPageInfo],Dict[int,Tuple[float,float]]] rasterize_pdf(pdf_path: Path, out_dir: Path, dpi: int = 300, max_pages: Optional[int] = None)
methods.description: Rasterizes a PDF into PNG images for each page, saving them in the specified output directory, and returns a list of page info and page sizes.

ctags.name: rasterize_pdf
ctags.pattern: /^def rasterize_pdf(pdf_path: Path, out_dir: Path, dpi: int = 300, max_pages: Optional[int] = None/
ctags.signature: (pdf_path: Path, out_dir: Path, dpi: int = 300, max_pages: Optional[int] = None)
